correctness.rationale: The four moment equations equal e1,...,e4 and form a regular sequence in p>=5. Vandermonde rank and first s moment equations force exactly p equal nonzero entries, yielding binom(p+r,p) indicator singular supports. Local initial forms comprise two independent linears and, after elimination, nondegenerate q_(p-2) and q_(r-1) in disjoint variables, a regular sequence. This proves the associated graded ring, multiplicity 4 and the trichotomy. The finite checker corroborates jets, determinants and two exhaustive rational examples without being used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The problem is a natural exact singularity question for four consecutive positive-characteristic moments in a regime excluded by a cited normality bound. The new theorem gives every singular point, uniform local multiplicity 4 and a sharp three-phase tangent-cone geometry. These are structural and deformation-sensitive invariants across an infinite family, not isolated numerical special cases.
